mapper.update: CREATE STABLE IF NOT EXISTS `boer`.`device_message` ( `ts` TIMESTAMP, `id` NCHAR(50), `report_time` TIMESTAMP, `tenant_id` BIGINT, `server_id` NCHAR(50), `upstream` BOOL, `reply` BOOL, `identifier` NCHAR(100), `request_id` NCHAR(50), `method` NCHAR(100), `params` NCHAR(2048), `data` NCHAR(2048), `code` INT, `msg` NCHAR(256) ) TAGS ( `device_id` BIGINT )
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO `boer`.`device_message_${deviceId}` USING `boer`.`device_message` TAGS (${deviceId}) ( `ts`, `id`, `report_time`, `tenant_id`, `server_id`, `upstream`, `reply`, `identifier`, `request_id`, `method`, `params`, `data`, `code`, `msg` ) VALUES (
${reportTime} '${@cn.hutool.core.date.DateUtil@format(reportTime, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS")}' , '${id}',
${reportTime} '${@cn.hutool.core.date.DateUtil@format(reportTime, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS")}' , ${tenantId != null ? tenantId : 0}, '${serverId != null ? serverId : ""}', ${upstream != null ? upstream : false}, ${reply != null ? reply : false}, '${identifier != null ? identifier : ""}', '${requestId != null ? requestId : ""}', '${method != null ? method : ""}', '${params != null ? params : ""}', '${data != null ? data : ""}', ${code != null ? code : 0}, '${msg != null ? msg : ""}' )
mapper.select:
SELECT `ts`, `id`, `report_time`, `tenant_id`, `server_id`, `upstream`, `reply`, `identifier`, `request_id`, `method`, `params`, `data`, `code`, `msg` FROM `boer`.`device_message_${deviceId}` WHERE `reply` = ${reply} AND `request_id` IN
'${requestId}'
ORDER BY `ts` DESC
